title: X&R Tag
description: A tag minigame for minecraft, designed to be used on a separate world from any SMPs or permanent projects.
body:
The function xnr_tag/start_game will put players in spectator mode, clear their inventory, give them a bit of gear, and set a small worldborder in a random spot in your world. One person is selected as the tagger, and the others are set as runners. The runners may fly to wherever they would like to start the game in, but the tagger is released 20 seconds later above the center of the map. 

The tagger's goal is to tag another player by punching them or hitting them with a projectile, while the runner's goal is to not be tagged. Really innovative stuff, I know. When someone is tagged, they are frozen for 5 seconds to let their tagger escape. You cannot use a crafting table, but loot drops of gear spawn every few minutes that can help you tag or evade other players. 

If you stay crouched for too long, you may start to glow in order to dissuade cheesy strategies. The hunters have some gear including soul soil and soul speed boots to help them chase. Other than that, have fun tagging your friends and use the function xnr_tag/tag_me if anyone gets too annoying!
